description: Métro du réseau STAR : ouvrages secondaires is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by public.sig.rennesmetropole.fr. Polygons materialising the service and ventilation wells of the metro, as well as the entrance and exit wells of the metro tunnels. The data from line b have been provided by SEMTCAR as of 12/07/2012. This date corresponds to deliberation C12.253 of the Agglomeration Council to close the public inquiry phase. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Metro of the STAR network: secondary works" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
